```{r}
scaled=function(x,mean_,sd_){
  x_scaled=(round(x,3)- round(mean_,3))/round(sd_,3)
  return( round(x_scaled,3))
  
}

x1_scaled=scaled(0.00632,x1_mean,x1_sd);x1_scaled

x2_scaled=scaled(18,x2_mean,x2_sd);x2_scaled

x3_scaled=scaled(0.538,x3_mean,x3_sd);x3_scaled

y_scaled=scaled(24,y_mean,y_sd);y_scaled
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
z=function(x,w){
 prod= x%*%w
 return(prod)
  
}
z(1:3,1:3)

x=c(1,-0.417,-0.487,-0.740)
w=c(0.5,1.2,-2.5,0.8)
z_val=round(z(x,w),3)

relu <- function(x) pmax(0, x)
relu(z_val)

heaviside <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(x >= 0)
}

heaviside(z_val)

sigmoid <- function(x) {
  1 / (1 + exp(-x))
}

round(sigmoid(z_val),3)
```

```{r}
yhat=0.62
x1_st=	-0.417
x2_st=	-0.487
x3_st=	-0.740
y_st=	-0.101
alpha=0.1
w0=0.5
w1=1.2

w0.der=round(-(y_st-yhat),3);w0.der

w1.der=round(-(y_st-yhat)*x1_st,3);w1.der

w0_new=round(w0-(alpha*w0.der),3);w0_new


w1_new=round(w1-(alpha*w1.der),3);w1_new

```

```{r}
#Q17

library(caret)
library(neuralnet)
pima=read_csv("pimaDiabetes.csv")
str(pima)
```

```{r}

set.seed(1)
y=factor(pima$testDiabetes, levels=c(0,1))
pima$testDiabetes=factor(pima$testDiabetes, levels=c(0,1))
inds=createDataPartition(
  y,
  times = 1,
  p = 0.8,
  list = TRUE,
  groups = min(5, length(y))
)

nrow(pima)*0.8;length(inds[['Resample1']])
#nrow(pima)*0.2;length(inds[['Resample2']])


training=pima[inds[['Resample1']],]
test=pima[-inds[['Resample1']],]


scale_training=data.frame(scale(data.matrix(training[,-ncol(training)]), center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
scale_training$testDiabetes =training$testDiabetes
scale_test=data.frame(scale(data.matrix(test[,-ncol(test)]), center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
scale_test$testDiabetes =test$testDiabetes

```

```{r}
pima_nn <- neuralnet(
 testDiabetes ~ .,
  data = scale_training,
  hidden = c(3),
  act.fct = "logistic",
  linear.output = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
plot(pima_nn)
wei_ghts=pima_nn$weights[[1]]
total_w=length(wei_ghts[[1]])+length(wei_ghts[[2]]);total_w
```
